<sub>Re-pointed at 2026-09-20T11:03Z from `#9874` to `#10080`. objectui#9874 was RULED (director seat, summon #25, letter **A** — the landed shape stands) and CLOSED 2026-09-20T09:06:30Z, so the decision this card waited on is answered. ⭐ The answer does not by itself turn the gate green: the fixture at `react/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx:76` still TYPES its legacy body through `SpecAuthoredInput<typeof NavigationConfigSchema>`, and ruling A is what makes that a real drift rather than an open question. Read first-hand on the refreshed head (run 35505224765, job 106063778695, 2026-09-20T10:41:06Z): the gate is red on **exactly one** diagnostic, 80 of 81 turbo tasks succeeding — `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`, against `objectstack-ai/objectstack@4efb988a9410`. objectui#10080 is that repair, filed as a sub-issue of this card and inheriting its domain. ⛔ Same hold, ⛔ not a new one — and this target CAN close, which the previous one (a `needs-user-decision` card, H26) could not.</sub>

The one diagnostic left is `react/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx:76`, a fixture PR objectui#9936 inverted on purpose and which objectui#9874 — `needs-user-decision` — owns. ⇒ ⭐ this gate now waits on a DECISION, ⛔ not on more work. ⛔ Same hold, ⛔ not a new one. ⚠️ Still a lower bound: `Tasks: 27 successful, 30 total`, and `gridNavigationMembers-8071.test.tsx` (the other inverted pin) is unreported for an unmeasured reason — ⛔ not cleared. Full reading in comment 5738955865.</sub>

<sub>Re-pointed at 2026-09-19T01:47Z from `#9978 #9979 #9943` to `#9667`. All three earlier targets CLOSED and their PRs (objectui#9977, objectui#9981, objectui#9982) merged and content-verified; the gate re-ran on a synced head (`88c0b1d56`, check run `105816840308`) and the two diagnostics those cards owned are GONE. What the run reports now is SIX diagnostics, all authoring the one retired key `ListViewSchema.navigation.view` — objectui#9667's subject. ⛔ Same hold, ⛔ not a new one. ⚠️ The set may GROW: turbo printed `Tasks: 23 successful, 26 total`, so `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/react` never ran and their sites are unreported rather than absent. Full reading in comment 5738370138.</sub>

<sub>Re-pointed at 2026-09-19T00:24Z from the single `#9943` to all three, on the refreshed gate reading (check run `105804001660`, head `2b3836f07`). The gate now reports **2 diagnostics in 2 files** — `normalize-list-view.pageResidual-8429.test.ts:146` (objectui#9978) and `object-validation-engine.test.ts:162` (objectui#9979) — and ⛔ neither is objectui#9943's `plugin-view` trio. objectui#9943 stays on the line anyway: the same run printed `Tasks: 18 successful, 24 total` failing at `@object-ui/core#type-check`, so **6 tasks never ran** and plugin-view may be among them. ⛔ Its absence from the table is not evidence of its absence from the break — that is objectui#9944's lower-bound property, and this is what it looks like from the inside.</sub>

<sub>`Blocked-by:` repointed at 2026-09-18T22:16Z. ## Maintainer ruling — recorded verbatim

Presented by the `domain:skills` seat in its chat with the maintainer on 2026-09-18 (after the seat's reading of PR #18971: 31 files, +238,310 / −119, of which 18 generated files carry +237,706 and 13 hand-written files +604 / −90; no human review; landed by the spec seat through the queue on a contract-review record). The three options, verbatim:

> - **A. 保留,尽快接线**:#18976 落地,让分片 diff 成为条款②信号。成本是 12 MiB 长期留在仓库,收益取决于复核员认真读 diff。
> - **B. 生成器保留,快照移出仓库**:CI 里对上一个 release tag 重新生成并 diff,把 diff 贴到 PR 上作为条款②信号;仓库里不存 12 MiB。同一个读者、同样可读,重量归零。这会改您 09-06 的裁决,所以是您的字。
> - **C. 回退这个 PR,用消费方编译代替**:objectui / cloud 对 spec@main 的编译作为唯一形状门禁。最轻,但只覆盖被消费的那部分导出。

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「C」 (chat, 2026-09-18, about 11:33Z on the seat's clock; a chat reply carries no platform stamp). This supersedes ruling 5560224701 (director batch #60, 2026-09-06, option A) on #16045.

## What this card carries (the objectui half)

Under option C the ONLY shape gate for `@objectstack/spec`'s public surface is a real consumer compiling against the current `main` of objectstack. objectui is the first consumer: a CI job in this repository that builds `@objectstack/spec` from objectstack `main` (git-sha, the pin discussion of 2026-09-18 with the maintainer: sparse checkout or a packed tarball, ⛔ not a full clone per run) and typechecks objectui against it — REQUIRED, not advisory, from the moment it exists. What it replaces: the declaration-text snapshot PR #18971 added on objectstack, now being reverted (objectstack #19011). What it must say when red: which objectui file fails against which objectstack commit, so the objectstack PR that moved the shape is the one that answers.

Boundaries: ⛔ this is not the pin-bump discussion's answer (who bumps the pin stays open with the maintainer); ⛔ cloud's half is not this card's — that repository is outside the filing seat's write scope and is named to the maintainer in chat.
